========================================================================
MOUNT EVEREST HIGHER SECONDARY SCHOOL - CERTIFICATE PRINTING STUDIO
(CBSE Affiliation No. 1230048 | Taphou, Senapati - 795106, Manipur)
========================================================================

STANDALONE PORTABLE EDITION (Windows 10 / Windows 11)
- NO Python installation required.
- NO extra drivers or packages required.
- Self-contained and portable (runs from USB drive, Desktop, or Program Files).

UPDATES & MULTI-COMPUTER DISTRIBUTION:
1. When updates are released, users can receive updates in 3 ways:
   a) Online / Network: The app checks automatically on startup or via the "🔄 Updates" button.
   b) Local School Network: Place the update package on a shared Wi-Fi/LAN folder (e.g. \\SERVER\Updates).
   c) Offline / USB: Click "🔄 Updates" -> "Select Update Package (.zip) & Install" and choose the .zip provided.
2. User data (student records in certificates.db, alignments in custom_positions.json, and output PDFs)
   are ALWAYS preserved and never lost during updates.

QUICK START:
1. Double-click "CertificateStudio.exe" (or "Launch Certificate Studio.bat") to open the application.
2. Under "Batch Processing (Excel/CSV)", templates are readily available in the "samples" folder.
3. All exported and printed certificate PDFs are automatically saved in the "Output_Certificates" folder.
